sections.text:
-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Light and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes frenzy.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 30 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 60 seconds.
-Target: All allies including the Rear Guard. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases the Ability Power of Soldier/Rook's physical/magic Abilities by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
